source_caption:
Ryan Gosling is officially joining the MCU as Ghost Rider. 🔥

Marvel revealed the casting during its Hall H presentation at San Diego Comic-Con, where Gosling shared that Ghost Rider is a character he has wanted to play for a long time. The film will be directed by Shawn Levy, who previously directed Deadpool & Wolverine, and is set to release in 2028.

Fans have been waiting years for this moment. Back in 2022, Gosling said Ghost Rider was the Marvel character he most wanted to play, and after years of rumors and speculation, it is finally official. The film will also mark Gosling’s first superhero movie.

What do you think of Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider?

source_details.synopsis: Ghost Rider is a 2007 American superhero film written and directed by Mark Steven Johnson. Based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name, it was produced by Columbia Pictures in association with Marvel Entertainment, Crystal Sky Pictures, and Relativity Media, and distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing. The film stars Nicolas Cage as the titular character, with Eva Mendes, Wes Bentley, Sam Elliott, Donal Logue, Matt Long, and Peter Fonda in supporting roles. Its story follows Johnny Blaze, a motorcycle stuntman who sells his soul and becomes the Ghost Rider, a bounty hunter of evil demons.
